# ClientAggregateNode

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.Nodes.ClientAggregateNode`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`

## Summary

Computes aggregate functions client-side from raw (non-aggregated) input rows. Used for aggregates that FetchXML doesn&#x27;t support natively (STDEV, VAR). Collects all input rows, groups them if needed, and computes the aggregates.
